uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

4113-4125-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by tapping Shipwreck Dowser due to Splash Portal's convoke ability, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

767-3755-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-3755-4687.description:
Activate Elven Chorus by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

2533-3899-5925--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-3025.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

1895-4399-4518-7818.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2452-3249-5173-6798.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2590-5776-6791-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

2034-4802--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat.

1765-2440-6791-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-6791-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

671-2919-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-2919-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

5220-5231-6537-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

3836-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

4311-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Artist's Talent's first ability triggers. Choose not to discard a card.
Repeat

2457-4094-4289-6791.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

880-5702-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5702-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2440-2703-4785.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

1379-3259-5953-6633.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1379-3259-5953-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-5953-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

224-5233-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

1808-2511-6291.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

359-813-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
359-813-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4315-5200-5390.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns and Careful Cultivation attached to the same creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
4315-5200-5390.description:
Activate the creature with both permanents attached to it using the ability from Careful Cultivation by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns's first activated ability by paying {1}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
4315-5200-5390.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

397-671-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-671-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

730-2178-5627.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
730-2178-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
730-2178-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1257-4543-5536.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Walking Atlas exiled with brain counters on them.
1257-4543-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Walking Atlas's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Rex using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Rex.
Repeat.

969-2463-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2463-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping Soul Foundry and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1144-3510-3972.description:
Yavimaya causes all lands to be Forests in addition to their other types, thus Life and Limb causes all lands to be 1/1 Saproling creatures.
Because Ethereal Absolution gives all creatures your opponents control -1/-1, they die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Whenever an opponent plays a land, it will also die as a state-based action.

2060-2226-4017.description:
Activate Zacama's third ability by paying {2}{W}, causing you to gain three life.
Sunbond triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

553-4586.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
553-4586.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Endless Detour by paying {G}{W}{U}, putting Approach of the Second Sun on top of your library.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

1486-3457-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-3457-4875.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability, untapping it.
Repeat.
